answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a jetty that only admits ships that have paid harbour dues. Reputation then grows slowly, like a glacier, through verified completed work, not self-declared claims. A garden of peers periodically audits random jobs and slashes the stake of any identity caught duplicating work or faking attestations, so creating many fake agents multiplies the locked capital at risk instead of multiplying rewards.
